title: Gate event
description: One JSON line per gate decision. Metrics are queries over these lines. An autopilot line (`kind` = `autopilot`) records an autopilot run's event instead; gate metrics skip it.

schema_version.description: The version of this line's shape. A new optional field keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped field bumps it. A line written before it existed has none and reads as version 1.

loop_version.description: The loop contract's version (`loop.version` in roles.json) the change ran under. A major bump means the steps, the approvals, or the lanes changed, so metrics across it compare two different loops.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the decision.

repo.description: The repository as the adapter names it (`owner/name` on GitHub, the project path on GitLab).

tenant.description: The tenant the repository's config names, or null. `aidd metrics --tenant` and `aidd record export --tenant` filter on it.

head_sha.description: The head commit the gate judged; empty when the run could not tell.

spec.description: The Spec's path in the repository, or null for a change without a Spec.

spec_id.description: The Spec's id, so a cost ledger or another system can join on it. Null for a change without a Spec.

spec_hash.description: The Spec hash this run evaluated. A new hash after Spec approval means the Spec was reworked after approval.

trace_id.description: The trace id that joins this decision to the change's other events, or null.

owner_team.description: The Spec's owner_team, so metrics can group changes by team. Null for a change without a Spec.

route.description: The route the gate applied (minor, standard, normal, major, or emergency), or null when it could not tell.

required_route.description: The lowest route the changed paths and risk require, or null when it could not tell.

declared_route.description: The route the change declared when the gate raised it (a normal Spec raised to major); null otherwise.

type.description: The change type (feat, fix, docs, and so on), or null.

profile.description: The profile in force; null when the gate could not read a config.

decision.description: The verdict, or `error` when the run crashed and posted an error status instead of a decision.

error.description: For an error event: the exception type, never its message (which could carry data from the change).

pending_rules.description: The rules still waiting, such as for an approval.

changed_files.description: How many files the diff changes.

changed_lines.description: Lines added and deleted that the change budget counts.

untouched_tasks.description: Tasks of the Spec that changed nothing in their scope: the plan and the diff disagree.

platform.description: github, gitlab, local, or another adapter.

config_sha256.description: sha256 of the effective config text, to tell presets apart.

opened_at.description: When the PR/MR was opened (RFC 3339), from the platform; null when unknown. The start of time to first feedback for the change's first head.

head_pushed_at.description: When the judged head reached the platform (RFC 3339); locally, its committer date; null when unknown. Time to first feedback is measured from it.

duration_seconds.description: How long it ran, in seconds; null when unknown.

flaky.description: True when it passed only after a retry; `aidd metrics` counts it.

tests.description: Green test results on the head.

kind.description: What the line records: `gate`, a gate decision (the reading when absent); `autopilot`, an autopilot run's event, held in `run`; or `test`, one `aidd test` run, held in `test`. aidd writes the last two into the git directory, never the working tree.

test.description: One `aidd test` run on this machine, for `aidd metrics`' suite runs per head. A record, never evidence: the gate reads the evidence file, never this line.

base_sha.description: The base it ran red on, or would have.

result.description: `pass` when every result was good (`aidd test` exited 0).

red.description: Whether it ran the new-behavior commands on base (false with `--no-red`).

partial.description: Whether it ran only some commands (`--changed`, a file): the gate does not accept a partial run.

commands.description: The test commands it ran on head.

duration_seconds.description: The time its commands took, red and green.

run.description: An autopilot run's event: the run started, a step was done, the run waits on a person, is blocked, reached a limit, or finished. A notifier sends only waiting_on_person, blocked, limit_reached, and finished. `aidd metrics --autopilot` reads them all.

session_id.description: The session that holds the run's lease.

work.description: The lease's work: a Spec, Epic, or Initiative id, a label, or `all`.

spec_id.description: The Spec the step was about, when there is one.

result.description: For step_done: the result `aidd autopilot note` recorded.

flow.description: The team command the step ran.

who.description: For waiting_on_person and blocked: who decides.

reason.description: For limit_reached and finished: why the run stopped; for blocked, `stalled` when the stall breaker stopped it.

tokens.description: The tokens the step used, when the note records them.

cost.description: What the step cost, when the note records it.
